policy: NOTHING IS APPLIED. Every row above is a proposal backed by an existing mapping, for a human to accept or reject in config/category_mapping.csv. Mapping a category changes which rows reach every model-ready table, so it is a taxonomy decision, not a data-cleaning one.
modelling_impact: UNMAPPED and OUT_OF_SCOPE rows stay in all_incidents for auditability but never reach a model-ready table. Accepting the high-confidence proposals would move 76,306 rows into scope, changing the category prior every model sees and the density features of neighbouring incidents.
